text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English.
zh: 大家好,欢迎收看《Real Easy English》。
zh_hant: 大家好,歡迎收看《Real Easy English》。

text: In this podcast, we have real conversations
zh: 在这个播客中,我们进行真实的对话
zh_hant: 在這個播客中,我們進行真實的對話

text: in easy English to help you learn.
zh: 用简单的英语来帮助你学习。
zh_hant: 用簡單的英語來幫助你學習。

text: I'm Georgie.
And I'm Beth.
You can find a video of this podcast
zh: 你可以找到这个播客的视频
zh_hant: 你可以找到這個播客的影片

text: and a worksheet to help you practice what you've learnt
zh: 一份帮助你巩固所学内容的练习册
zh_hant: 一份幫助你鞏固所學內容的練習冊

text: on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
How are you today, Beth?
I'm very well, thank you.
How are you?
Yes, I'm pretty good, thank you.
Good.
So, what are we talking about today?
zh: 那么,我们今天要谈什么呢?
zh_hant: 那麼,我們今天要談什麼呢?

text: Well, Beth, today we are talking about places.
zh: 好的,Beth,今天我们来聊聊地方。
zh_hant: 好的,Beth,今天我們來聊聊地方。

text: We'll talk about the city and the countryside
zh: 我们将谈谈城市和乡村。
zh_hant: 我們將談談城市和鄉村。

text: and which we prefer.
Very nice.
OK, let's start then.
So, Georgie,
if you were going to visit somewhere, for example,
zh: 比如说,如果你要去某个地方旅行,
zh_hant: 比如說,如果你要去某個地方旅行,

text: would you prefer to visit the city or the countryside ?
zh: 你更喜欢去城市还是乡村？
zh_hant: 你更喜歡去城市還是鄉村？

text: Are we talking about the UK or going abroad?
zh: 我们是在说英国国内,还是出国?
zh_hant: 我們是在說英國國內,還是出國?

text: Let's start with the UK.
OK.
If I visit somewhere in the UK,
zh: 如果我要去英国某个地方旅游,
zh_hant: 如果我要去英國某個地方旅遊,

text: I would usually want to go
to the countryside .
That's because I live in a city.
zh: 那是因为我住在城市里。
zh_hant: 那是因為我住在城市裡。

text: I live in London, but I'm from the countryside ,
zh: 我住在伦敦,但我来自乡下。
zh_hant: 我住在倫敦,但我來自鄉下。

text: so sometimes I crave going out
zh: 有时候我会很想出去走走
zh_hant: 有時候我會很想出去走走

text: into a more rural area where I can see more green space,
zh: 搬到一个更乡村的地方,那里能看到更多绿地
zh_hant: 搬到一個更鄉村的地方,那裡能看到更多綠地

text: there's more wildlife.
It's almost like you need to escape the, the busy
zh: 感觉就像你需要逃离那种忙碌一样
zh_hant: 感覺就像你需要逃離那種忙碌一樣

text: hustle and bustle of the city.
Yeah.
D'you know, I completely agree with you.
zh: 你知道吗,我完全同意你的看法。
zh_hant: 你知道嗎,我完全同意你的看法。

text: Cities in the UK are great.
There are some great cities, but I have visited
zh: 我去过一些很棒的城市
zh_hant: 我去過一些很棒的城市

text: quite a lot of them.
And after a while
the cities are all similar.
Whereas the countryside , you can do different activities.
zh: 而在乡下,你可以做各种不同的活动。
zh_hant: 而在鄉下,你可以做各種不同的活動。

text: It's really nice to see new places.
zh: 看看新地方真的很不错。
zh_hant: 看看新地方真的很不錯。

text: I, a few years ago,
I went to Kent and I had never been to Kent before
zh: 我去了肯特郡,以前从未去过那里。
zh_hant: 我去了肯特郡,以前從未去過那裡。

text: because I'm from the north of England
zh: 因为我来自英格兰北部
zh_hant: 因為我來自英格蘭北部

text: and Kent is in the south,
and it was amazing.
They had different kinds of buildings
zh: 他们有不同类型的建筑
zh_hant: 他們有不同型別的建築

text: and like architecture on the farms.
zh: 我也喜欢农场里的建筑。
zh_hant: 我也喜歡農場裡的建築。

text: We don't have those same kind of roofs
in the farms in the, in the north.
Yeah, I also went to Kent last year.
I did, but I went to the seaside
zh: 我是去了,不过我去的是海边
zh_hant: 我是去了,不過我去的是海邊

text: because Kent also has a bit of coastline.
zh: 肯特郡也有一段海岸线。
zh_hant: 肯特郡也有一段海岸線。

text: Yeah.
And yeah, I really enjoyed visiting Kent.
zh: 我确实很喜欢参观肯特郡。
zh_hant: 我確實很喜歡參觀肯特郡。

text: And the villages are so like cute
zh: 这些村庄真的太可爱了
zh_hant: 這些村莊真的太可愛了

text: and picturesque , we could say.
What about when you go abroad?
Do you, do you also visit the countryside in other countries?
zh: 你也会去其他国家的乡下旅游吗?
zh_hant: 你也會去其他國家的鄉下旅遊嗎?

text: I have done, but to be honest,
zh: 不过说实话,我已经做完了。
zh_hant: 不過說實話,我已經做完了。

text: I would normally go to a city if I go abroad,
zh: 如果我出国的话,通常会选择去城市。
zh_hant: 如果我出國的話,通常會選擇去城市。

text: maybe the capital city or maybe a smaller city.
zh: 也许是首都,也许是一个较小的城市。
zh_hant: 也許是首都,也許是一個較小的城市。

text: But one of the reasons for that, I think,
zh: 但我认为,其中一个原因是,
zh_hant: 但我認為,其中一個原因是,

text: is the transport.
It's so much easier to get a train or a bus
zh: 坐火车或坐公交车方便多了
zh_hant: 坐火車或坐公交車方便多了

text: when you're in a city.
And you'd have to hire a car, I think,
to visit a village or something like that.
zh: 去一个村庄之类的地方。
zh_hant: 去一個村莊之類的地方。

text: It's very true.
Usually if you go abroad,
you fly to an airport and the airports are usually closer to the city.
zh: 你飞到机场,而机场通常离市区更近。
zh_hant: 你飛到機場,而機場通常離市區更近。

text: And if you only have a few days in a place,
zh: 如果你在一个地方只待几天,
zh_hant: 如果你在一個地方只待幾天,

text: it's easier to just stay in the city.
It's also, I guess,
easier to do lots
of, like, activities in the city
zh: 像是城市里的各种活动
zh_hant: 像是城市裡的各種活動

text: when you visit and try out
lots of the local restaurants,
everything is closer together so you can do more things.
zh: 所有东西都离得更近,这样你就能做更多事情。
zh_hant: 所有東西都離得更近,這樣你就能做更多事情。

text: Well, I'm just thinking if you're in the city
zh: 嗯,我只是在想你是不是在市里
zh_hant: 嗯,我只是在想你是不是在市裡

text: you can, like, search
zh: 你可以,比如说,搜索一下
zh_hant: 你可以,比如說,搜尋一下

text: on your phone for really good restaurants really easily.
zh: 用手机就能非常轻松地找到非常好的餐厅。
zh_hant: 用手機就能非常輕鬆地找到非常好的餐廳。

text: But if I'm in Italy,
for example, and I don't speak Italian,
zh: 比如说,我不会说意大利语,
zh_hant: 比如說,我不會說義大利語,

text: it would be really difficult, I think,
for me to find a good restaurant
because I wouldn't know where to go.
zh: 因为我不知道该去哪里。
zh_hant: 因為我不知道該去哪裡。

text: Sometimes it's the locals
in the countryside that are able to tell you this.
zh: 能在乡下告诉你这些的人。
zh_hant: 能在鄉下告訴你這些的人。

text: It might not even be on the internet.
zh: 这甚至可能都不在网上。
zh_hant: 這甚至可能都不在網上。

text: Yep.
That's very true.
And hustle and bustle , the busyness and noise
that you find in the city.
We had picturesque , which means pretty or beautiful.
zh: 我们学过picturesque这个词,意思是漂亮的或美丽的。
zh_hant: 我們學過picturesque這個詞,意思是漂亮的或美麗的。

text: We often use this to describe a place.
zh: 我们经常用这个来描述一个地方。
zh_hant: 我們經常用這個來描述一個地方。

text: And visit , to go somewhere for a short time.
zh: Visit,意思是去某个地方待一小段时间。
zh_hant: Visit,意思是去某個地方待一小段時間。

text: That's it for this episode
of Real Easy English.
Go to our website to find a worksheet to test what you've learned.
zh: 访问我们的网站,找一份练习题来测试一下你学到的内容。
zh_hant: 訪問我們的網站,找一份練習題來測試一下你學到的內容。

text: bbclearningenglish.com And next week we'll be talking about gifts.
zh: bbclearningenglish.com 下周我们将谈论礼物。
zh_hant: bbclearningenglish.com 下週我們將談論禮物。

text: So see you then.
Goodbye.
